<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

If child footprints lie within the parent and are mutually exclusive, every realized plan’s combined leaf requests are duplicate-free and covered by the root footprint.

Canonical source: [Composition.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Composition.lean)
